title: Opportunity List
prompt: List page for the JobPulse interview tracker. Same indigo-accent identity as the Dashboard draft. Top: page title in Chinese plus primary indigo-700 button on the right. Below title: search input (full width) plus horizontal chip-group filter (active chip in indigo-700). Vertical stack of opportunity cards (rounded-xl, white bg, border-neutral-200, shadow-xs, hover indigo-700 border + shadow-sm). Each card: company + position as title, metadata line (salary, city, work hours, weekend-off), leading-dot status indicator on right. Empty state: small geometric illustration in indigo-200 plus text. 1440x900 single artboard. Match Dashboard identity exactly.

title: New Interview Form
prompt: Quick-add form page for new interview. Same identity. Page title with cancel + primary indigo-700 save buttons on right. Form fields default-open: (1) BASIC: company name required, position name required. (2) FIRST INTERVIEW: first interview time (clean button that opens 10-min Chinese calendar picker), format dropdown (online video / onsite / phone), location (single text input). (3) META 2-col grid: contact/HR, source dropdown (Boss / la-gou / referral / headhunter / company-site / other), salary range (2-col: range dropdown 8-10K to 50K plus months dropdown 12 to 16). Below: single collapsible section (default closed) with benefits multi-select tag pills, work hours dropdown, weekend-off checkbox, JD link, JD textarea, notes. Form width max-w-2xl centered. Labels: text-xs font-medium text-neutral-700 tracking-wide uppercase. Inputs: bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-lg focus:border-indigo-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-700/20. 1440x900. Match Dashboard identity.

title: Opportunity Detail
prompt: Detail page for one job. Same identity. Top: back link on left, Edit (ghost) + Delete (text-red-700) buttons on right. Header: opportunity title (text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight) plus city. Right: status select with leading dot. Optional indigo-50 call-to-action card (only if status is offered/accepted AND final info missing) with text plus indigo-700 link. Then 4-col overview cards (rounded-xl, p-4, shadow-xs): xin-zi / gong-shi / fu-li / shuang-xiu with uppercase labels and values. If JD exists: heading plus pre-formatted monospace JD on a card. Then heading mian-shi-lun-ci plus primary indigo-700 tian-jia button. Then vertical stack of round cards (rounded-xl, shadow-xs, border-neutral-200, hover indigo-700 border): each shows round number + type + time + format + outcome indicator (leading dot plus label). Under each pending round: two text buttons (yi-tong-guo in green-700, wei-tong-guo in red-700). 1440x1100. Match Dashboard identity.
